entities.summary: Elias Viktor Zebulon Lindholm is a Swedish professional ice hockey player who is a forward for the Boston Bruins of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was selected by the Carolina Hurricanes in the first round of the 2013 NHL entry draft, and spent his first five NHL seasons with them.
